bibl.title: Glossary to Odyssey VIII in a new papyrus fragment from the Leipzig Papyrus- und Ostrakasammlung.
bibl.seg: Daniela Colomo, Glossary to Odyssey VIII in a new papyrus fragment from the Leipzig Papyrus- und Ostrakasammlung.

Marco Ercoles, Lara Pagani, Filippomaria Pontani & Giuseppe Ucciardello (edd.), Approaches to Greek Poetry. Homer, Hesiod, Pindar, and Aeschylus in Ancient Exegesis = Trends in Classics. Supplementary Volumes. 73 (Berlin - Boston, 2019) pp. 61-79, figg.
bibl.note: Editio princeps of P.Lips. inv. 1397, a fragment of a first-century AD papyrus roll of unknown provenance containing a glossary to Odyssey VIII. Layout and script point to a professional book production. - Appendix. P. Ant. III, 150 [= MP3 1199.200; LDAB 1841], Glossary to Iliad XVI 100(?)–150.
